about: Which local model LuckyLook uses, picked from this PC's specs when it starts (and by install.bat, which downloads it).
With a graphics card: the first row whose memory_gb the card has (GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes; an '8 GB' card reports about 8.5).
Without one (or one too small for any row): the first row the PC's RAM has. These run on the CPU, so they're smaller.
Sizes leave room for the conversation and the 0.3 GB search-by-meaning model next to the chat model.
To force a model on your own PC, set MODEL in local_settings.py instead of editing this file.
